input.content: Pattern: flipping a config default (e.g. DETAILED_REPORT False -> True) sends every default-mode call through a previously opt-in code path, including boundary inputs the old default never reached. In batch-report, stats.summarize computes sum(values)/len(values) when detailed=True and has no empty-input guard. As a result, report([]) went from "Items: 0" to ZeroDivisionError, which breaks the contract that empty batches are valid in either mode. The diff updated only the populated default test, so the suite stayed green. Review check: when a default flips, list the boundary cases the new default path handles (empty, zero, None) and require a default-mode test for each one the contract covers.
